svg.title: Capability landscape for modern skill evaluation frameworks
svg.desc: An ordinal matrix comparing sixteen frameworks across skill identity, paired skill lift, stateful execution, trace evidence, executable checks, behavioral and semantic scoring, safety and static validation, and search or evolution. The matrix encodes native, strong, adapter, or outside-scope support and does not rank overall product quality.
svg.text: Capability landscape: where each framework is strongest
Documented support as of 2026-08-30. This is a capability map, not a benchmark score.

g.text: Three-tier skill QA and live lift

g.title: NVIDIA SkillEvaluator: Paired skill lift - native
AWS sample skill-eval: Skill identity - native
AWS sample skill-eval: Paired skill lift - native
AWS sample skill-eval: Stateful world - adapter
AWS sample skill-eval: Trace evidence - strong
AWS sample skill-eval: Executable checks - strong
AWS sample skill-eval: Behavior + semantics - native
AWS sample skill-eval: Safety + static - native
AWS sample skill-eval: Search + evolution - none
Inspect AI: Paired skill lift - adapter
OpenAI Evals: Paired skill lift - adapter
Pydantic Evals: Paired skill lift - adapter
Microsoft SkillOpt: Paired skill lift - strong

g.text: Outside the framework's center of gravity

svg.text: Read by column, not by row total: complete skill evolution requires execution, evidence, and promotion controls that often span multiple products.
